### workspace layout --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace layout <subcommand> [--name WS] [args]

Subcommands:
  save [name]                Save the current pane layout (default name: 'default')
  restore [name]             Restore a saved layout (default name: 'default')
  list                       List saved layouts for a project
  save|restore <project> <name>   The same, for a named project
  list <project>                  The same, for a named project

Options:
  --name WS                  The project, instead of the current directory's.
                             One argument to save/restore is always the layout name.

Layouts are auto-saved as '_before_resize' whenever you run 'workspace resize',
so you can always undo with: workspace layout restore --name <project> _before_resize

Examples:
  workspace layout save                     # current directory's project, as 'default'
  workspace layout save coding              # current directory's project, as 'coding'
  workspace layout restore --name myproject # restore 'default' for a named project
  workspace layout save myproject coding    # PROJECT NAME: save as 'coding'
  workspace layout list myproject           # show saved layouts
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace layout save --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace layout save [--name WS] [NAME]
       workspace layout save PROJECT NAME

Save the project's current tmux pane layout under NAME (default: 'default').

The project's tmux session must be running. A layout saved under an existing name is replaced.
Outside a workspace it is a usage error unless you give --name or PROJECT NAME.

Options:
    --name WS                    The project, instead of the current directory's; then give only NAME. One argument is always the layout name
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace layout save    # save the current directory's project as 'default'
  workspace layout save coding    # save the current directory's project as 'coding'
  workspace layout save --name myproject    # save a named project as 'default'
  workspace layout save myproject coding    # PROJECT NAME: save a named project as 'coding'
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace layout restore --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace layout restore [--name WS] [NAME]
       workspace layout restore PROJECT NAME

Apply a saved tmux pane layout to the project's running session (default NAME: 'default').

`workspace resize` saves the layout it found as '_before_resize'.
Outside a workspace it is a usage error unless you give --name or PROJECT NAME.

Options:
    --name WS                    The project, instead of the current directory's; then give only NAME. One argument is always the layout name
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace layout restore    # restore 'default' for the current directory's project
  workspace layout restore coding    # restore 'coding' for the current directory's project
  workspace layout restore --name myproject    # restore 'default' for a named project
  workspace layout restore --name myproject _before_resize    # undo the last resize
  workspace layout restore myproject coding    # PROJECT NAME: restore 'coding' for a named project
--- stderr
--- end

--- stdout

### workspace layout list --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace layout list [--name WS | PROJECT]

List the names of the project's saved layouts.

'_before_resize' is listed once a resize has run.
Outside a workspace it is a usage error unless you give PROJECT or --name.

Options:
    --name WS                    The project, instead of PROJECT or the current directory's
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace layout list    # layouts saved for the current directory's project
  workspace layout list myproject    # layouts saved for a named project
  workspace layout list --name myproject    # the same, named with --name
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace layout --bogus
--- exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Unknown layout subcommand: --bogus

Usage: workspace layout <subcommand> [--name WS] [args]

Subcommands:
  save [name]                Save the current pane layout (default name: 'default')
  restore [name]             Restore a saved layout (default name: 'default')
  list                       List saved layouts for a project
  save|restore <project> <name>   The same, for a named project
  list <project>                  The same, for a named project

Options:
  --name WS                  The project, instead of the current directory's.
                             One argument to save/restore is always the layout name.

Layouts are auto-saved as '_before_resize' whenever you run 'workspace resize',
so you can always undo with: workspace layout restore --name <project> _before_resize

Examples:
  workspace layout save                     # current directory's project, as 'default'
  workspace layout save coding              # current directory's project, as 'coding'
  workspace layout restore --name myproject # restore 'default' for a named project
  workspace layout save myproject coding    # PROJECT NAME: save as 'coding'
  workspace layout list myproject           # show saved layouts
